properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 26 at 9:39AM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Coastal waters from Pascagoula Mississippi to Stake Island
Louisiana out 20 to 60 NM...

At 939 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorm, capable
of producing winds to around 30 knots. This thunderstorm was located
50 nm south of Farewell Buoy. The thunderstorm was nearly stationary.

The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, and dangerous lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe
harbor immediately until this activity passes.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or nearest law enforcement
agency. They will relay your report to the National Weather Service
forecast office.
properties.area: Coastal waters from Pascagoula Mississippi to Stake Island Louisiana out 20 to 60 NM

.Minor flooding continues along the lower White River from Petersburg
to Hazleton. Minor flooding also continues on the Wabash River from
Montezuma down to Mount Carmel with the crest approaching Vincennes.

to impact main stem river levels.

round.

- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 20.2 feet
tomorrow morning. It will then fall below flood stage Saturday
afternoon.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 26 at 9:05AM CDT until August 26 at 12:00PM CDT by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
FFWPAH

The National Weather Service in Paducah has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Wayne County in southeastern Missouri...

* Until noon CDT.

* At 905 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Piedmont, Greenville, Sam A. Baker State Park, Lake Wappapello
State Park, Williamsville, Lodi, Shook and Mill Spring.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
